Thanks — I'm Redwood's security lead on this intake. A few operational details and links to get Jordan Health started:

1) DSQ (vendor questionnaire): please start here — https://dsq.vendorquestionnaire.com/start?company=JordanHealth&ref=DEAL-8743. Fill the contact details and we will prefill control owners where possible. Typical turnaround: 3–5 business days for the questionnaire; artifact requests may add time.

2) Trust Portal access: I provisioned a read-only view for Jordan Health. We can either:
   - Create a temporary portal account (30-day expiry) — we need name + email + preferred timezone; OR
   - Send a SAML invite (if you can accept SSO).
   Portal onboarding doc: see attached (redwood_trust_portal_instructions.pdf). Portal link: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/onboard/DEAL-8743

3) SOC 2 delivery: I'll upload a redacted 2027 Type II report to the portal once we have the contact confirmed. If you prefer SFTP, share an SSH key and we will place the file in a secure bucket.

4) Bridge letter: Ben has the template. Once Jordan Health confirms any redlines, we will route for signature.

Security notes: we tag all requested artifacts with access expiration and audit logs; we record who downloaded what. If you need HIPAA-specific evidence or data flow diagrams for your privacy team, let me know and we'll surface the relevant docs.

Please reply with: (a) portal user(s) name + email; (b) whether an NDA is required prior to access; (c) preferred delivery method for the SOC 2 PDF (portal vs SFTP).
